# Editorial Components

This is a layout specimen, not a laboratory or a complete book edition. All
numbers in its tables are synthetic formatting examples.

## Titles and running heads

Body prose uses the reading face; headings and navigation use the sans-serif
face. A section can contain **emphasis**, *terminology*, a [descriptive link](https://antoniofloresgil.github.io/FromConceptToSiliconBook/),
and an inline identifier such as `accelerator_configuration_and_status_register`.
The following levels remain available in the body even when the PDF contents
omit them.

### Subsection hierarchy

Keep a heading with its following paragraph. Use semantic Markdown headings
rather than manual font sizes, numbering, or page breaks inside a chapter.

#### A fourth heading level

This level is subordinate to the subsection and remains visually distinct.

@tbl-specimen-metrics aligns numerical columns to the right. Use explicit column
widths for long descriptions; keep units in headings and preserve original
precision. Long tables repeat their headers when they cross a PDF page.

## Code and long lines

The following snippet demonstrates formatting only; it is not an executable lab.

```systemverilog
always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
  if (reset) accumulator <= '0;
  else if (enable) accumulator <= accumulator + operand;
end
```

```bash
python tools/design/preview_editorial.py --output-dir labs/build/editorial-template-preview
```

Long inline identity: `sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef`.
Line wrapping must preserve every character; HTML code blocks retain horizontal
scrolling and their copy controls.

## Notes, warnings, and footnotes

::: {.callout-note title="Evidence boundary"}
An integrity check validates recorded artifacts; it does not rerun the experiment.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Reading suggestion"}
Read the interface contract before changing the implementation.
:::

::: {.callout-warning title="Unverified configuration"}
Changing a parameter does not qualify the resulting hardware.
:::

::: {.callout-important title="Preserve the reference"}
Keep retained results separate from student work and fresh executions.
:::

::: {.callout-caution title="Physical checks remain separate"}
Timing closure does not establish manufacturing qualification.
:::

A footnote adds supporting detail without interrupting the main argument.[^detail]
